_about: Sites the pipeline's fuzzy geocoder (Photon) put far from the town or townland their address names. Each is moved to that place and marked as placed to the town only. Generated with the same town check the pipeline now runs (pipeline/geocode.ts, townCheck); applied by scripts/prepare-data.mjs until the pipeline output includes the fix.
